_doc: Dialogue graphs. A node has text and choices; a choice may carry 'if' (conditions, all must hold) and 'do' (script ops, same language as level scripts), then 'goto' a node or 'end'. %n is replaced by the speaking character's name.

hello.text: A lantern swings up. "Customers! Down here! Tamsin, peddler, at your service. The robbers paid well for rope and lamp oil, and then the cold came up the stairs and I stopped wanting to leave."

robbers.text: "Five of them, with a stone wrapped in a sack like a baby. They went through the plate crypt. The old gate there only stays up while something heavy sits on the plate, and they left one of their own lying on it. The ooze has been dragging him off a bone at a time. Mind the rats."

below.text: "The Cistern. Water, and the lights that walk on it. Robbers took a girl down with them, a lock-picker. I heard her swearing through the floor for a day, then nothing."

hello.text: The woman in the cell squints at your torch. "You are not them. Good. They left me here to watch the stair and forgot the watching needs feeding."

choices.text: Come with us. We are after the Sealstone.

caged.text: "The lever for this cage is in the guard room, across the channel. Do not ask me how I know which lever. I know levers."

where.text: "Down, to the Gate Hall. They thought the stone would buy their way past something called the Warden. It did not. I heard it take them."

joined.text: Maren steps out and rolls her shoulders. "My knives went down with them. I will want them back."
